card: Replaces hardcoded extended key strings (tpub/tprv) across ten functional test files with keys generated via the test framework ExtendedPrivateKey helper. This completes the adoption of the BIP 32 helper classes introduced in PR #35543. It is an internal test suite cleanup with no effect on node behavior or user-facing functionality.
changed_since_previous: No substantive changes; rebased or updated against current master.
evidence: PR description: "This PR is a follow-up of PR #35543. I've updated the tests that were still using hardcoded keys, and used the `ExtendedKey` classes instead."
problem: Multiple functional tests still relied on hardcoded extended key string literals rather than the `ExtendedKey` test framework helper classes, leaving inconsistent test patterns across the test suite.

risk.why: Test-only changes replacing mock key strings; any defect would cause immediate functional test failures in CI without impacting node operation.

scope_notes: Mechanical test framework cleanup spanning ten functional test files.
summary: Replaces hardcoded BIP 32 extended key strings (`tpub` and `tprv`) across ten functional test scripts with keys derived using the `ExtendedPrivateKey` test framework helper. In most tests keys are generated dynamically, while `wallet_miniscript.py` derives deterministic keys using seeded generation.
